name: Soave harvest-site closure
question: Is leaving the inner-cheek buccal graft harvest site open noninferior to closing it for oral pain after substitution urethroplasty?

design.population: 135 patients with urethral stricture treated by buccal mucosa graft substitution urethroplasty.
design.description: Randomized noninferiority trial of cheek donor-site management
design.locator: PubMed abstract, Design, setting, and participants; Intervention; Results and limitations

verdictNote: Nonclosure met the reported noninferiority conclusion for pain intensity and affective quality.
takeaway: Among patients undergoing buccal graft substitution urethroplasty, leaving the cheek harvest site open was noninferior to closure for oral pain intensity and affective pain quality at each assessed postoperative time point.

reports.label: Primary randomized report
reports.citation: Soave A, Dahlem R, Pinnschmidt HO, et al. "Substitution Urethroplasty with Closure Versus Nonclosure of the Buccal Mucosa Graft Harvest Site: A Randomized Controlled Trial with a Detailed Analysis of Oral Pain and Morbidity." *Eur Urol.* 2018;73(6):910-922. doi:10.1016/j.eururo.2017.11.014

results.measure: Noninferiority of nonclosure versus closure at each postoperative assessment
results.note: The abstract reports noninferiority but gives no arm scores, margin, effect estimate, or confidence interval.
results.locator: PubMed abstract, Outcome measurements and statistical analysis; Results and limitations

results.measure: Noninferiority of nonclosure versus closure at each postoperative assessment
results.note: The abstract identifies oral pain quality as coprimary and specifies affective quality in its noninferiority result; no margin or arm scores are supplied.
results.locator: PubMed abstract, Outcome measurements and statistical analysis; Results and limitations

results.endpoint: Time from urethroplasty and oral pain
results.measure: Covariate effect of postoperative time on pain intensity and sensory, affective, and total pain quality
results.note: Generalized linear mixed models; the abstract gives no direction or magnitude.

results.measure: Association of graft length with pain intensity and sensory and total pain quality
results.note: Covariate effects from generalized linear mixed models; direction and magnitude are not given in the abstract.
results.locator: PubMed abstract, Outcome measurements and statistical analysis; Results and limitations

harms.label: Oral donor-site morbidity
harms.note: Reported domains were bleeding, swelling, numbness, altered salivation and taste, and impaired mouth opening, smiling, whistling, diet, and speech; arm-specific rates are absent from the abstract.

values.exp: Inner-cheek harvest site left open (72 patients)

delivery.label: Patient-reported assessment schedule
delivery.value: Before surgery; postoperative days 1, 5, and 21; months 3 and 6
